name: Handbag
instruction: Imagine a handbag with a top handle and a detachable shoulder strap. The bag should have a front flap with a clasp for closure. Could you design this?

Shape accuracy: The handbag has a top handle.
There is a detachable shoulder strap.
The bag features a front flap.
The flap has a clasp for closure.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The top handle is proportionate to the bag size.
The shoulder strap length is adjustable.
The front flap covers the opening of the bag.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The top handle is positioned at the top center of the bag.
The shoulder strap attaches to the bag securely.
The front flap overlaps the bag opening for secure closure.
Object distance and contact: The top handle does not interfere with the flap closure.
The shoulder strap connects to the bag without gaps.
The clasp on the flap engages smoothly for closure.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
There are no deviations from the instructions.
